title: Audit #5561 free helper endpoints against the #5550 P104 endpoint contract (no new κ)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spL?thread=cmsg_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spLHyt4JgKMsPAX3AsS4XP6dx)_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Audit, no new κ.** Hypothesis (c) of #5561 ("free helper START and FINAL frames"), which also covers the mid-frame start of #5553, is the general helper-endpoint contract that the unmodified P104 `local.py` already implements. Chris R's independent #5550 audit checked that contract on the #5545 word.

- `native()` credits each helper with the rank of `chart(initial)⁻¹·chart(final)` for any nested pair of frames, and prices two normalizers per helper as ordinary routes. #5550 makes the mechanism explicit: each endpoint lowers to U = M_left·G_r·M_right. M_right⁻¹ is applied to the fresh helper input before LOCAL and M_left⁻¹ after it, so a helper from E to B delivers G_r, with r = dim B − dim E, on an arbitrary fresh input. Starting higher lowers the credited rank by exactly the removed climb. PROOF.md gives the chart-invariant argument.
- The #5545 word audited by #5550 already has **192 nonzero helper starts and 65 below-FULL finals** (40 endpoint pairs). The #5561 headline word has fewer of both: 58 and 44.
- The canonical-start rule cited in #5561 belongs to the #4610/#5413 neutral caller, whose helper adapters J are pure coordinate permutations. It is not a P104 predicate. The T74 lineage has the same wrapper mechanism (#458 Lemma A entering helpers; #591 hyperplane-ended helpers).

Remaining obligations, not touched here: #5561's retime legality, pricing and strictification (its own verifier); its claim lines versus the certified endpoints .00308142 / .003076879 (as in the intake record); admission of the #5551 parent; inherited local native semantics; the five framework assumptions.

## Task and overlap

Base `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`. Source #5561 head `452d27dde67ee9f772dbbd3be129db97a8ecb9c1`; its two words are byte copies in `inputs/`. Card `scalar-to-moment`, scope **refined**: an audit of the changed frame itinerary already proposed in #5561. The intake record lists free-frame admissibility as "a separate unverified hypothesis". Before starting, I checked open PRs through #5564 and main for an existing check and found none. Nearest work: #5550 (checker reused), #5548, #5557, #5561, #5553.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-free-endpoint-contract-audit
```

Result: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`, Python 3.12, about 2 min 47 s, standard library only.

- **Positive control.** The patched #5550 checker, with four literal input lines swapped in a temporary copy (the canonical capsule is untouched), runs on the #5545 word and invoice. It reproduces #5550's complete frozen output `b51a7d19c10faea7d569a48e9536db8ba1e7418f8dd8dfb25646cc87cc9c4009` byte for byte.
- **#5561 headline word: PASS.**
  - 527 helper endpoints, 272 exact signed-Pauli and phase-anchor checks.
  - Invoice recounted as 66,852 paid / 12,814 productive.
  - Ordinary passes 124,232,680 ≤ 184,647,552.
- **#5561 starts-only word: PASS.** 278 exact checks, 67,374 / 12,814, ordinary passes 124,754,680.
- **Negative controls.**
  - A changed helper endpoint is rejected.
  - A changed invoice is rejected.
  - All ten #5550 controls reject on each word.
- **Also run, outside the package.** #5561's own `verify.py` was re-run unchanged and passed on both parts (raw crossings as stated there).

The P104 lineage (#2305/#2152/#2219) and all retained contributors are credited in the cited packages. Prepared with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code.

## Open next questions

The #5551 admission. Correction of #5561's claim lines to its certified endpoints. A deterministic generator for the #5561 retime. Details are in the README and TASK.json.
